text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One afternoon, during the last few<n>days of the
summer training camp...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That's right! First we gather the<n>crew... and then
we lay it down on the<n>beach!

text_block_list.name: Girlie C
text_block_list.text:
Us, throwing a summer rager? You're<n>a genius! Say
less!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Right?!
choice_data_list: What are you guys up to?
What are you guys up to?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Come on, Tray-Tray. Summer equalsparty, duh!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
The guy who owns the beach was<n>high-key down,
so all that's left is to<n>drop the hottest summerfest
ever!<n>Wahey heeey! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
To summarize, Helios wants to gather<n>people who
are interested in<n>participating in a beachside party.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You coming, T-Rain? Actually, scratch<n>that—you're
coming. Let's rock these<n>vibes together! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Mmkay, I'm gonna go grab the<n>homies! Let's
actually gooooo! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Since then, Helios has devoted every<n>spare
moment outside of training<n>toward preparing her big
festival.<n>Sadly...

text_block_list.name: Girlie D
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Heliboss?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Waugh... What the... My head... Where<n>even am I?
choice_data_list: The camp lodge. You collapsed of heatstroke.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For real? Ugh... I thought these<n>blinking lights I'm
seeing were a<n>disco ball.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, forget that! What about the<n>summerfest?!
We're not gonna make<n>it in—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Auuugh... Everything's so spinny...
choice_data_list: They said you have to stay put for a while.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: No way! But then I'll—hngh!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
T-Rain... You're not gonna say we<n>can't party,
right? Right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I wanna throw down! Everyone's<n>putting in work
for it, and I wanna<n>make it happen! And, and...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: And I promised to make you a real<n>party animal!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You'd be a real one for sure if you<n>could ride the
wave at a major rager.<n>So please?
choice_data_list: I see... You wanted to keep your promise.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I can't just let her hard work go to<n>waste. If I want
to pay her kindness<n>back, then the show must go
on!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huhwha? T-Rain? Uh, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Where are you going? Wait!
choice_data_list: Rest easy and leave it to me!
Rest easy and leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! What the—don't just leave me<n>here! Oww!
My head hurts...

text_block_list.name: Girlie A
text_block_list.text: PT! How's Heliboss? Is the fest<n>canned?
choice_data_list:
The party's still happening, and I'm taking the
helm!

The party's still happening, and I'm taking the
helm!

text_block_list.name: Girlie B
text_block_list.text: Huh?! For real?! You, PT?!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, an outdoor party on the beach.<n>I've been
wondering what our<n>students were up to.
choice_data_list:
Would you like to join? I'll make sure it's fun for
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I'd be happy to. My trainee was just<n>saying she
wanted to take a break,<n>so this is perfect. I'll see if
any other<n>trainers are interested too.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With the help of Helios's friends and<n>the other
trainers, we manage to get<n>everything at the venue
set up. And<n>so, the next day...

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Let's party! WOOOOO!
choice_data_list: A-aight, put your hands up!

text_block_list.name: Girlie B
text_block_list.text: Bwa ha ha! Serve, PT! You're so in<n>your zone!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text: Don't leave us out! Yaaaaay! Put<n>your hands uuup!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
EDM echoes across the sands.<n>Trainees and
trainers alike find<n>themselves swaying to the
rhythm.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
When Helios taught me how to enjoy<n>a groove,
she shone brighter than<n>ever before.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to do everything I can to<n>pump up the
vibes just like her!

text_block_list.name: Girlie A
text_block_list.text: Even my trainer is popping off! She'sgoing way too hard, wahaha! It'scrazy seeing her like this!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: T-Raaaaain! Put me in there tooooo!
choice_data_list: Helios?! Are you feeling—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I can't stay down after seeing all this!<n>Check it! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Both the students and the trainers<n>have a great
time partying on until the<n>festivities come to a close.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Oh, man. Can't see the fireworks<n>from here, huh?
choice_data_list:
You could have joined everyone else on the open
stage.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I can't just leave you here alone<n>when you're
crashing. And listening<n>to the fireworks is still a
midsummer-type beat, yeah? Gets<n>me in my
feelings!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Despite what she says, her ears and<n>tail fidget
restlessly. She must've<n>been looking forward to
the<n>fireworks. In that case...
choice_data_list: Helios! Look, fireworks!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Pft, hah! Where'd you get those<n>pom-poms?!
choice_data_list:
They were part of the summerfest. But see?
Fireworks!

They were part of the summerfest. But see?
Fireworks!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! ♪ You're the goat, T-Rain!<n>Lemme try!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fireworks! Fireworks! Gimme a big
one—giga-firework! ☆ Oh yeah, I'm<n>getting pumped!
choice_data_list: Hey, Helios.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's up?
choice_data_list: Do you think I'm a real party animal now?
Do you think I'm a real party animal now?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Are you kidding?! No cap, no lie, no<n>doubt! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You really showed me your party soul<n>today. You
were so peak! Literally on<n>fire!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And I was like, "I gotta keep up!<n>Lemme show what
I've got too!" So<n>basically...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Next time, you'll get to see me run a<n>fire race. ☆
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I'm still far from<n>understanding party
culture... but the<n>passion comes through. It makes
me<n>want to support her all the more.

text_block_list.name: Us
text_block_list.text: P-p-pow! Fireworks, wahey! ☆
